tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background: Home, Library, Settings, sheets. Warm paper, never pure white.

tokens.name: surface-paper
tokens.usage: Reader page in the Paper theme; the dark value is the Night theme.

tokens.name: surface-sepia
tokens.usage: Reader page in the Sepia theme (light only; Night or Black replaces it when the system is dark).

tokens.name: surface-black
tokens.usage: Reader page in the Black theme: pure black for OLED, text in night-text. Reader only; the app around it stays on surface.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, grouped lists, chips at rest, sheet contents.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass fill for floating buttons, popovers and menus, always with glass-blur.

tokens.name: surface-glass-strong
tokens.usage: Glass fill for popovers, menus and the settings sheet, where text sits on it.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px inner edge of every glass element.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. Also the fill of solid buttons and selected chips (their label uses on-ink).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: authors, captions, page counters, section labels. 4.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Chevrons and disclosure icons only, never text.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink-filled control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Progress, the active theme ring, section labels like CONTINUE READING, Cancel/Done in sheets, checkmarks. One accent, used sparingly.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind an active accent control, e.g. the pressed goal ring.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent-filled control.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of progress bars, rings and sliders; grabbers.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 0.5px separators inside grouped lists and menus.

tokens.name: control-fill
tokens.usage: Background of segmented controls, steppers and the search field.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: 0.5px border of outlined pills and chips at rest.

tokens.name: word-tap
tokens.usage: Momentary tint behind the word the reader tapped, while the bubble is open.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection (long press) with its handles in selection-handle.

tokens.name: selection-handle
tokens.usage: Selection handles and carets.

tokens.name: highlight-yellow
tokens.usage: Default highlight colour in the text. Solid swatch: highlight-yellow-solid.

tokens.name: highlight-green
tokens.usage: Highlight colour 2.

tokens.name: highlight-blue
tokens.usage: Highlight colour 3.

tokens.name: highlight-pink
tokens.usage: Highlight colour 4.

tokens.name: highlight-purple
tokens.usage: Highlight colour 5.

tokens.name: highlight-yellow-solid
tokens.usage: Colour swatch in the highlight menu and the bar in the Highlights list.

tokens.name: highlight-green-solid
tokens.usage: Swatch / list bar for green.

tokens.name: highlight-blue-solid
tokens.usage: Swatch / list bar for blue.

tokens.name: highlight-pink-solid
tokens.usage: Swatch / list bar for pink.

tokens.name: highlight-purple-solid
tokens.usage: Swatch / list bar for purple.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive menu items: Remove from Library, delete highlight.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim behind modal sheets (Add Book, Add to Collection). Popovers and the reader sheet use no scrim.

tokens.name: night-text
tokens.usage: Book text in the Night reader theme.

tokens.name: sepia-text
tokens.usage: Book text in the Sepia reader theme.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The app name in the Home header. Nowhere else.

styles.name: title-book
styles.usage: Book title under the hero cover on Home.

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: Book title inside a card row.

styles.name: list-serif
styles.usage: Chapter names in Contents, book titles in list rows.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: Title on a generated cover (books without cover art).

styles.name: reading-body
styles.sample: Als Gregor Samsa eines Morgens aus unruhigen Träumen erwachte
styles.usage: Default book text (size step 3 of 7). Line height stays a whole number of pixels so a page clips on a line boundary.

styles.name: reading-quote
styles.usage: Quoted passage in the Highlights list.

styles.name: translation
styles.usage: The translation inside the bubble; 22px/600 inside the card.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headers on Home, screen titles in the nav bar.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Rows in grouped lists and menus, inputs.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Segmented controls, chip labels, page numbers in Contents.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Secondary lines under titles; IPA and grammar line in the bubble is 12px.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Page counter, meta under highlights, cover captions.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Uppercase labels (apply text-transform: uppercase). In accent when it introduces the primary action, else ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon-to-text in tight pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between a title and its subtitle.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between covers in a row, between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and sheet inner padding, gap between sheet sections.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter. Every screen keeps 20px left and right.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between major blocks on Home.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Reader text margin left and right.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Breathing room above a hero.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Bottom inset above the home indicator for the last block on a screen (64px on Home).

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target: glass buttons, rows in menus (46–50).

tokens.name: nav-top
tokens.usage: Top of the nav bar row below the status bar.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tapped-word tint, small cover thumbnails, highlight ends (3px).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Book covers in grids and rows (8px for the hero cover).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Search field, segmented controls, steppers, icon toggles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Grouped list cards in Settings and sheets, chapter rows.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards on Home, popovers, bubbles (20–22), menus.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero card and the bottom toolbar.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and modal sheets, top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, glass circles (44/48px), toggles, colour swatches.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: White cards on the paper surface.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass buttons and toolbars. Deliberately faint: Liquid Glass draws its own depth; in SwiftUI use .glassEffect() and no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, bubbles (bubbles: 0 8px 24px 0.12).

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-cover
tokens.usage: Every book cover: a soft drop and a 3px lighter spine on the left.

tokens.name: shadow-cover-hero
tokens.usage: The one large cover on Home; the coloured glow takes the cover's own hue.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for glass buttons; 24px for bubbles, 30px for popovers and sheets.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter saturate paired with glass-blur (1.5 on popovers).

tokens.name: hairline-w
tokens.usage: Separator thickness on Retina.
